page_title: EIN 2-0 MON | Eintracht Frankfurt v B. Monchengladbach 21/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Tobias Welz is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

90+1' Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Tobias Welz blows his whistle for a foul.
87' The shots on goal statistics – 4:8.
85' Dino Toppmoller prepares a substitution. Hugo Larsson is replaced by Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt).
84' We are about to witness a subsitution. Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) for Omar Marmoush.
83' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the right post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
83' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

80' 2 - 0 Goal! Jean-Matteo Bahoya manages to prod the ball to Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the roof of the net. 2:0.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rocco Reitz departs the field of play to be replaced by Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach).
78' Substitution. Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) has come on for Ansgar Knauff.
78' Dino Toppmoller has decided to make a change. Igor Matanovic (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Hugo Ekitike.
75' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) meets a cross inside the box, but Kaua Santos wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.

73' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Moritz Nicolas anticipates well and smothers the ball.
71' Substitution. Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) replaces Nathan Ngoumou.
71' Substitution. Julian Weigl leaves the pitch and is replaced by Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach).
71' Gerardo Seoane decides to make a substitution. Robin Hack will be replaced by Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach).
70' Here comes a substitution. Fares Chaibi is given a rest as he is replaced by Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt).

70' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
68' B. Monchengladbach take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

67' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) latched on to a cross inside the six-yard box and headed at goal. If it wasn't for one of the defenders making a save on the goal line, he would have been celebrating a goal now. The ball goes out of play. B. Monchengladbach are awarded a corner kick.
66' A loose pass is instantly latched onto by Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach). He tries his luck from the edge of the box with a measured shot, but it hits the left post and is cleared to safety.
66' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) commits a foul and Tobias Welz immediately signals a free kick.
64' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

63' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Moritz Nicolas guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The ball goes behind for a corner. Eintracht Frankfurt will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

62' Fine attempt! Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
61' The possession of the ball – 41:59.
58' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
57' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
55' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Kaua Santos.
53' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

53' This shall not pass! Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. The referee signals a corner kick to B. Monchengladbach.
49' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) was too forceful with his tackle and Tobias Welz interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
48' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

47' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.

46' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Kaua Santos.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' Tobias Welz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) is penalised for holding. Tobias Welz signals a set piece.
42' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

41' A fine solo run by Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
41' The total number of attempts is 7:6.

40' Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the resulting free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up inside the left post, but Kaua Santos pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
39' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Tobias Welz didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
37' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner which is cleared.
36' The ball is cleared after Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
36' The resulting set piece from B. Monchengladbach is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
35' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. B. Monchengladbach will take a corner kick.
33' The corner from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is intercepted by Moritz Nicolas.

33' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Eintracht Frankfurt will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

30' 1 - 0 Goal! Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Ansgar Knauff inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. 1:0.
30' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
29' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
28' That's unlucky! Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
27' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) steps up and sends the free kick straight into the defensive wall.
26' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.

25' Great ball in from Omar Marmoush. Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
24' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for B. Monchengladbach.

23' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. B. Monchengladbach force a corner. They send men into the box.

23' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
23' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
22' The resulting corner, taken by Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt), comes to nothing.
21' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
19' Moritz Nicolas leaps to intercept the corner kick from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt).

19' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
19' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
17' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from B. Monchengladbach.

14' The free kick from a promising distance is taken by Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the left post. What a chance! The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
13' The whistle blows and Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) is booked for an infringement.
12' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Kaua Santos.
9' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
8' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The linesman signals a throw-in for Eintracht Frankfurt.
7' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
6' The corner kick from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
5' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt). Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick.
5' A poor mid-range free-kick by Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is easily blocked by the defensive wall.
4' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Eintracht Frankfurt win a free kick.
2' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
1' The first half has started.
B. Monchengladbach will kick the game off.
Tobias Welz will referee today's match.
